# Gallery

Every diagram type that Pele supports, rendered by zensical-pele with the
examples from the [Pele documentation](https://pele.run/examples). Each page
shows the diagrams, with the Markdown that produced them in a second tab.
Switch the color scheme in the header and the diagrams change with it.

<div class="grid cards" markdown>

-   :lucide-blocks:{ .lg .middle } [**Block**](block.md)

    ---

    Show blocks in a grid that you arrange yourself.

-   :lucide-boxes:{ .lg .middle } [**C4**](c4.md)

    ---

    Show a software system as people, systems, containers, and components.

-   :lucide-braces:{ .lg .middle } [**Class**](class.md)

    ---

    Show classes, their members, and the relationships between them.

-   :lucide-database:{ .lg .middle } [**Entity relationship**](er.md)

    ---

    Show entities, their attributes, and the relationships between them.

-   :lucide-calendar-range:{ .lg .middle } [**Event modeling**](eventmodeling.md)

    ---

    Show how commands, events, and views change a system over time.

-   :lucide-workflow:{ .lg .middle } [**Flowchart**](flowchart.md)

    ---

    Show the steps and decisions in a process.

-   :lucide-chart-gantt:{ .lg .middle } [**Gantt**](gantt.md)

    ---

    Show the tasks of a project on a timeline.

-   :lucide-git-branch:{ .lg .middle } [**Git graph**](git.md)

    ---

    Show commits, branches, and merges.

-   :lucide-kanban:{ .lg .middle } [**Kanban**](kanban.md)

    ---

    Show tasks in columns by status.

-   :lucide-brain-circuit:{ .lg .middle } [**Mindmap**](mindmap.md)

    ---

    Show ideas branching out from a central topic.

-   :lucide-binary:{ .lg .middle } [**Packet**](packet.md)

    ---

    Show the fields of a network packet.

-   :lucide-chart-pie:{ .lg .middle } [**Pie**](pie.md)

    ---

    Show the parts of a whole.

-   :lucide-chart-scatter:{ .lg .middle } [**Quadrant chart**](quadrant.md)

    ---

    Plot items on two axes that divide the chart into four sections.

-   :lucide-list-checks:{ .lg .middle } [**Requirement**](requirement.md)

    ---

    Show requirements and how they relate to each other and to the elements that satisfy them.

-   :lucide-waves:{ .lg .middle } [**Sankey**](sankey.md)

    ---

    Show flows between nodes, with widths proportional to quantity.

-   :lucide-arrow-right-left:{ .lg .middle } [**Sequence**](sequence.md)

    ---

    Show the messages that participants exchange over time.

-   :lucide-circle-dot:{ .lg .middle } [**State**](state.md)

    ---

    Show the states of a system and the transitions between them.

-   :lucide-milestone:{ .lg .middle } [**Timeline**](timeline.md)

    ---

    Show events in chronological order.

-   :lucide-footprints:{ .lg .middle } [**User journey**](journey.md)

    ---

    Show the steps of a task and how satisfying each one is.

-   :lucide-chart-line:{ .lg .middle } [**XY chart**](xychart.md)

    ---

    Plot data as bars and lines on two axes.

-   :lucide-bot:{ .lg .middle } [**Agentflow**](agentflow.md)

    ---

    Show the tasks of AI agents and how work passes between them.

-   :lucide-server:{ .lg .middle } [**Architecture**](architecture.md)

    ---

    Show services and the connections between them.

-   :lucide-grid-2x2:{ .lg .middle } [**Cynefin**](cynefin.md)

    ---

    Sort items into the five domains of the Cynefin framework.

-   :lucide-fish:{ .lg .middle } [**Ishikawa**](ishikawa.md)

    ---

    Show the causes that contribute to a problem.

-   :lucide-radar:{ .lg .middle } [**Radar**](radar.md)

    ---

    Compare values across several axes.

-   :lucide-route:{ .lg .middle } [**Railroad**](railroad.md)

    ---

    Show the syntax of a grammar.

-   :lucide-rows-3:{ .lg .middle } [**Swimlane**](swimlane.md)

    ---

    Show a process divided by who performs each step.

-   :lucide-folder-tree:{ .lg .middle } [**Tree view**](treeview.md)

    ---

    Show a hierarchy, such as files and folders.

-   :lucide-layout-dashboard:{ .lg .middle } [**Treemap**](treemap.md)

    ---

    Show hierarchical data as nested rectangles, sized by value.

-   :lucide-users:{ .lg .middle } [**Use case**](usecase.md)

    ---

    Show actors and the goals they reach with a system.

-   :lucide-squares-intersect:{ .lg .middle } [**Venn**](venn.md)

    ---

    Show sets and where they overlap.

-   :lucide-map:{ .lg .middle } [**Wardley map**](wardley.md)

    ---

    Plot components by their visibility to the user and their stage of evolution.
